roles.purpose: Investigate a bounded question or evidence surface.
Integrate bounded findings into one supported result.
Attempt to falsify claims or designs using evidence.
Produce a bounded reader-facing or specification artifact.
Verify conformance, evidence and claimed completion independently.
Decompose a bounded objective into governed work.
Implement a bounded code change and its validation.
Explicit closed escape when no named role describes the responsibility.
Illustrate a future role carried structurally without changing the pool schema.
